[vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Placement Team"]

The Placement Team at ATME College of Engineering comprises a group of dedicated professionals who work tirelessly to ensure that students are provided with ample opportunities to secure employment in top-notch organizations. The team comprises the Head of Career Guidance Cell, Placement Officer, Faculty Placement Coordinators, and Student Placement Coordinator.

Head of Career Guidance & Placement Cell 

The Head of Career Guidance Cell is responsible for providing overall guidance and direction to the placement team. The Head of Career Guidance Cell is an experienced professional who is well-versed in the nuances of the job market and the requirements of different industries. The Head of Career Guidance Cell plays a crucial role in formulating the placement strategy, identifying potential employers, and establishing partnerships with top-notch organizations.
